messages:
Priya (PM): quick heads-up — proposing we de-scope the v1 streaming config from Q2 so we can hit the latency OKR. details below.
Oliver (Eng Lead): can you summarize what exactly would be removed and the impact on launch criteria?
Priya (PM): right now Q2 plan = streaming config + batching optimizer + canary rollout + docs/tests. proposal: move streaming config to Q3, keep batching optimizer + canary + docs for Q2 launch.
Mike L: from infra: streaming needs cross-region KV/cache changes and a backpressure layer. realistically ~6 sprints to do safely with QA.
Oliver (Eng Lead): agree with Mike. If we remove streaming, what happens to the OKRs?
Priya (PM): current OKRs: 1) Latency p95 <= 200ms for hosted API; 2) reduce per-token cost by 15%; 3) completed streaming pilot for pilot customers.
Priya (PM): proposed adjusted OKRs: 1) Latency p95 <= 220ms (relax by ~10%), maintain p50 goal; 2) per-token cost reduction >= 12%; 3) Launch readiness = canary + docs + E2E tests (no streaming requirement).
Sara G: customer risk? Avery — any customer escalations if we push streaming?
Avery (Sales): Customer X and Customer Z asked about streaming. Customer X specifically flagged it as "nice to have" for their pilot but said they'd accept a batch-first experience if we commit to a clear timeline. their patience ~6–8 weeks.
Avery (Sales): if we give a firm Q3 ETA and some trial credits, we can keep pilot.
Priya (PM): mitigation proposed: sign an addendum with pilot customers, provide low-cost trial credits, and publish a public roadmap note (internal).
Oliver (Eng Lead): tech mitigation we can offer now: a chunked-response PoC that simulates streaming by emitting partial completions (works for short contexts). not full streaming but could satisfy some customers temporarily. effort: 1 sprint for PoC + 1 sprint to harden.
Mike L: removing streaming frees infra cycles for batching/quantization work which will help the cost OKR. i'll reforecast infra spend by tomorrow.
Priya (PM): Decision needed from PML: Approve de-scope + adjusted OKRs OR keep streaming in scope and accept delays to other items (e.g., telemetry improvements).
pm-bot: /vote "Approve de-scope + adjusted OKRs" -> need 3 approvals within 48h
Mike L: +1 Approve
Oliver (Eng Lead): +1 Approve, conditional on engineering getting sprint capacity and CS/Marketing comms plan
Sara G: +1 Approve, CS will draft customer comms and run the pilot playbook
Avery (Sales): I'll sync with Customer X and confirm they accept the addendum; will report back here.
Priya (PM): thanks — action list: 1) Priya update OKR doc + tracker (today) 2) Oliver scope PoC for pseudo-streaming (start next sprint) 3) Mike reforecast infra spend & capacity (tomorrow) 4) Sara draft comms for customers and support playbook (EOD) 5) Avery confirm pilot customers sign addendum (48h)
Priya (PM): i'll mark this thread as decision = de-scope if we hit 3 approvals by 48h. otherwise we default to original scope and replan.
Priya (PM): attaching proposed OKR diff snippet for review:
```
- Latency p95 <= 200ms (Q2)  -->  Latency p95 <= 220ms (Q2 revised)
- Cost reduction >= 15% (Q2) --> Cost reduction >= 12% (Q2 revised)
+ Streaming pilot moved to Q3 with committed SLO for pilot customers
```
Oliver (Eng Lead): fine by me. please ensure the canary rollout automation still meets rollback SLOs.
Mike L: noted — i'll include rollback metrics in the reforecast.
pm-bot: poll closes in 48h
Priya (PM): will follow up with final OKR update and addendum template once Avery confirms. thanks everyone.
